# @codeatlasdev/ui

> Svelte 5 component library. Documentation for AI agents has one canonical entry point: https://ui.codeatlas.com.br/llms.txt

https://ui.codeatlas.com.br/llms.txt lists a recipe for every screen type (app shell, list, form, settings, auth, landing, dashboard, theming), the decision tables, the common workarounds and the machine-readable endpoints. This file is generated from the same source and only points there.

- [llms.txt](https://ui.codeatlas.com.br/llms.txt): the canonical entry
- [Recipes](https://ui.codeatlas.com.br/docs/getting-started/recipes/): complete pages to copy
- [Choosing a component](https://ui.codeatlas.com.br/docs/getting-started/choosing/): X vs Y decision tables
- [Common workarounds](https://ui.codeatlas.com.br/docs/getting-started/workarounds/): what you are about to write, and what to use instead
- [llms-full.txt](https://ui.codeatlas.com.br/llms-full.txt): all docs in one file
- [Contributor guide](AGENTS.md): working on this repository (not for apps that consume the package)
- [Source](packages/ui/src/lib/index.ts): public exports
